title: GitHub Issue Triage
prompt: Triage the bounded set of open bug issues returned for the selected repository. Group by severity and impact, flag stale or blocked reports, and suggest reading order without changing issue state.
instructions: Search only the requested repository and issue filters. Read the full bodies of the returned sample issues with get_issue before proposing labels or priorities. Report the sample limit and do not imply complete repository coverage. Do not create comments, labels, branches, or edits; distinguish reporter facts from triage suggestions.
fixture_summary: Synthetic repository search returns three open bug reports; full issue reads reveal one release blocker and one reproducible low-severity defect.
